Assumption: Same row index means same patient
Reason: Datasets were collected independently and do not share verified patient correspondence.

Assumption: Random cross-modal samples are biologically paired
Reason: Random samples from different modalities cannot be interpreted as measurements from the same individual.

Assumption: Sample IDs can be inferred from array position
Reason: Array position is only a dataset-specific index and contains no cross-modal identity information.
Dataset sizes and class distributions differ substantially across modalities.
Knowledge-level pairing represents semantic relationships, not patient identity correspondence.
